description: Draft dose notes prepared from a user-supplied extract of BNF for Children 2023. Every note is marked unverified and must be checked against the complete current source before use. Version 2: adds drug-level targets (amikacin, procainamide, quinidine, theophylline, tobramycin, valproate, vancomycin), oxycodone strengths, ulipristal, morphine/diamorphine equianalgesic values and etravirine (flagged). Re-importing adds only regimens you do not already have.
